notes: I discovered the "bananaUPPER"→"bananaUPPF" anomaly is explained by a rule: uppercase "ER" collapses to "E" (the R is dropped) before the last-character shift is applied. This also explains "midUPPERend"→"midUPPEene" (R dropped, then final 'd'→'e'). All other evidence still fits the last-character +1 shift with wrap.
